kommareel: AWS 2017 as the pipeline states it: a comma before 'en', 'maar', 'want' or 'of' only when it joins two clauses that EACH have their own subject and verb. An imperative clause ('Verhit 'n vaste stof genoeg en dit verander ...') has no subject of its own and its 'en' is conditional, so it gets no comma. Every comma proposal in this list joins two declarative clauses with explicit subjects; none is of the imperative kind, so the imperative sentences stay as written.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'net die toestand verskil' is a second clause with its own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Two full clauses joined by 'en' take the AWS comma.

besluite.fout: 'en ... nogtans' carries a contrast stiffly, and 'nogtans' is a formal word for Grade 4.
besluite.rede: 'maar dit is tog daar' is the natural Afrikaans contrast and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die eerste is verhitting' and 'dit voeg hitte by' each have a subject and verb.

besluite.fout: The particle of 'wegvat' stands before its object phrase, and the AWS comma is missing.
besluite.rede: 'vat hitte van die materiaal weg' is the standard order and matches the glossary; the preposition 'van' is unchanged.

besluite.fout: 'en' joins a 'not this, only that' contrast.
besluite.rede: 'maar' marks the contrast the sentence makes; meaning unchanged, comma follows the AWS.

besluite.fout: none
besluite.rede: 'by die vrieskas uit in die kombuis in' is natural Afrikaans meaning 'into the kitchen', while 'na die kombuis toe' means 'towards the kitchen', which is wrong for a freezer that stands in the kitchen.

besluite.fout: 'en' joins a 'not this, only that' contrast.
besluite.rede: Same pattern as change 5; 'maar' marks the contrast without moving the meaning.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die bord word kouer' and 'die tafel word warmer' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.rede: 'het nog hitte in' is the Afrikaans form and the block's own pattern; nothing is lost.

besluite.fout: The time phrase wedged between subject and verb reads as if it describes the ice block.
besluite.rede: Fronting 'Op 'n warm dag' is the natural order and says exactly the same.

besluite.fout: none
besluite.rede: 'loop plat' is protected because it is the video's own wording, and the change also adds 'van die pan'.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Sjokolade smelt' and 'roomys smelt' each have a subject and verb.

besluite.fout: 'Die was' at the start of a sentence reads first as the verb or as 'the laundry'.
besluite.rede: 'Kerswas' removes the stumble for a Grade 4 reader and names the same thing.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Ons noem ...' and 'water word dan waterdamp' each have a subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Ons noem ...' and 'jy kan dit self sien' each have a subject and verb.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: 'Die ys hou nou sy eie vorm' and 'dit vloei nie meer nie' each have a subject and verb.

besluite.fout: 'Die gesmelte was' can read as 'the melted laundry' or the verb 'was'.
